finding.statement: Current main has replay-stable Forge execution identity, but measured_packet still includes volatile evaluated_at in training-bearing packet_text. Two fresh Distillery rebuilds that first observe the same measured execution through different timestamp/narration envelopes can therefore emit different packet bytes and token counts despite the same stable replay/measured identity.
finding.counterhypothesis: Stable replay identity alone is sufficient because duplicate admission prevents a second packet in one populated database.
finding.counterhypothesis_disposition: REJECTED_AT_REBUILD_SCOPE: duplicate admission inside one DB does not make fresh rebuild packet bytes deterministic when volatile observation time remains inside measured_packet.

delta.source_change: exclude evaluated_at from CLAY_DISTILLERY_FORGE_EXECUTION_PACKET/v2 training-bearing bytes; retain it metadata-only; derive measured evidence identity directly from the same replay-stable measured_packet preimage
delta.test_change: prove timestamp/narration invariance and fresh-DB rebuild equality of packet IDs, packet bytes, replay/measured digests and accepted token counts

go_tracks.track_a: ADVANCED_SOURCE_SCOPE: deterministic Forge-to-Distillery rebuild semantics strengthen executable EntityOS dataset convergence
go_tracks.track_b: ADVANCED_SOURCE_SCOPE: separates stable measured evidence from volatile observation metadata without creating a second truth/effect authority
go_tracks.track_c: ADVANCED_DATASET_SAFETY_SCOPE: prevents observation-envelope volatility from changing future training-bearing bytes; zero J-Space/model/training credit
